Corollaries

Cor. 1 1. If compact regular surface has K>0K>0K>0, then it is homeomorphic to S2S^2S2. 2. If compact surface is homeomorphic to S2S^2S2, then no way to deform it differentiably to have K<0K<0K<0 everywhere. Cor. 2 If compact connected regular surface SSS has K>0K>0K>0 everywhere, then any two closed geodesics intersect. Intersect × → 두 geodesic은 S2S^2S2 위 → 이 둘이 topologically 하게 cylinder를 이룸 → GB ⇒ ∬K dσ=0\iint K\,d\sigma=0∬Kdσ=0 → 모순. Jordan curve thm.
